findings.passage: “The 2nd Amendment Rights of Hoosiers shouldn’t end at the steps of the Statehouse,” he said in a written statement.
findings.note: Quoted by the Indianapolis Business Journal. Written statement from the Treasurer on a bill (HB 1084) letting more armed statewide officials carry at the Statehouse. The article also says he hoped to extend it to officials' staff next year.
subjects: carry a gun at the Statehouse

findings.motion: Testified for HB 1084, allowing more armed statewide officials at the Statehouse
findings.note: The IBJ reports that Treasurer Elliott testified for the measure. This is testimony, not a vote or sponsorship.
